text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Hosted ingress in us-east showing intermittent 502s and elevated tail latencies starting 08:30 UTC. Preliminary impact ~2% of requests. Mitigation actions initiated: traffic steering + node cordon. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2336009999

ash.sre: spotted correlated CrashLoopBackOffs on prewarm init containers in the new ingress rollout. pods failing during init -> autoscaler churn -> queue pileup.

tori.eng: confirm reproduces on canary image (ingress-service:v2.2.0). init process uses additional memory under load.

ash.sre: cordoning affected hosts (node-pool-e2) and routing traffic to healthy pools at 08:36 UTC.

sam.support: drafting customer message: "We're investigating intermittent 502 errors in US‑EAST affecting a small subset of traffic. Mitigation underway." Send to #customer-updates when ready.

tori.eng: rolling back ingress image to v2.1.9 where init prewarm is disabled. starting rollout @ 08:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deployment action: ingress-service rollback to v2.1.9 triggered by tori.eng at 08:41 UTC.

ash.sre: after rollback, CrashLoopBackOffs stopped. error rate dropping to ~0.4% at 08:48 UTC. KV-cache warming will take additional minutes.

ravi.pm: ETA for full recovery? customers pinging.

ash.sre: estimating 15-25m for error rate to reach baseline (<0.25%). will update on 5m stability window.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Metrics recovered to baseline (0.18% errors) at 09:00 UTC. Root cause (preliminary): memory spike in prewarm init on v2.2.0 causing pod restarts and autoscaler feedback loop. No customer data loss. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Runbook used: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingress-init-rollback

sam.support: customer-facing note published and pinned in #customer-updates.

ravi.pm: thanks all. please drop timeline + RCA into the postmortem doc. assigning owners: ash.sre (ops timeline), tori.eng (root cause + fix), sam.support (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
